narr: Remnants from Tropical Storm Harold lifted across the Desert Southwest. This, combined with already abundant subtropical moisture, resulted in widespread showers and thunderstorms across eastern Utah. Storms were slow moving and produced heavy rain. As a result of the heavy rain, some flash flooding occurred in portions of Grand County.

The woman and her dog were rescued by emergency services later with no injuries reported.
